when: PW-side ARP/ND request/response enters service with no IRB
expected_result: Flooded/forwarded to AC only; no Routing ARP/NDP row and no EVPN MAC-IP row
anti_pattern: Routing learns PW MAC-IP or proxy reply is generated

when: PW-side ARP/ND request/response enters IRB-attached service and IP is in IRB subnet
expected_result: Flooded to AC and punted to Routing; Routing ARP/NDP row plus EVPN MAC-IP row created
anti_pattern: DP flood works but Routing table remains empty

when: Proxy ARP/NDP has learned a PW-side host and receives requests
expected_result: AC-side requests may receive proxy reply; PW-side requests never receive generated proxy reply
